newsitem.title: UK: LCE white sugar holds in narrow range up to close.
newsitem.headline: LCE white sugar holds in narrow range up to close.

text.p: White sugar futures edged towards the lower end of the day's narrow trading range at the close under light liquidation orders.
This saw near October last trade at $348.00 a tonne, up $0.30 a tonne from Thursday, after a day's range of $349.50 to $347.30 a tonne. Turnover totalled 1,819 lots
The low was reached in the early afternoon as prices briefly dipped in response to news that Turkey will not need to import sugar in 1997.
But the move was short-lived "We all knew Turkey's crop was much larger this year and would be enough for domestic requirements," a trader said.
In the morning a high of $349.50 had been reached but there was not sufficient buying to test resistance stretching above this level. Support was still pegged around $345.00 for October.
But this range may be tested more and more as the October expiry date gets nearer, traders said
Paris October white sugar closed at $350.00, unchanged.
